title: The Corner Barbers | Traditional Barbershop, Liverpool
desc: Traditional barbershop in Liverpool. Skin fades, beard trims, hot towel shaves and kids cuts. Walk in or book online. Open six days.
sub: Skin fades, scissor work, beard sculpting and hot towel shaves in the heart of Liverpool. Six chairs, six days a week, and a brew while you wait.
svc_l: No hidden extras and no upselling. Walk in, sit down, and pay what is on the board.

services.title: Skin fade
services.desc: Clipper work taken down to the skin and blended properly. The cut we are known for.

services.title: Cut & style
services.desc: Scissor cut, washed, dried and styled with product that suits your hair, not ours.

services.title: Beard trim & shape
services.desc: Lined up with a razor, balanced to your face, finished with oil and a hot towel.

services.title: Hot towel wet shave
services.desc: The full traditional service. Hot towels, badger brush, straight razor, cold finish.

services.title: Cut & beard combo
services.desc: Full haircut and beard service together, and you save a fiver doing it.

services.title: Under 12s
services.desc: Kids cuts, no fuss, booster seat for the little ones and a lolly at the end.

about_h: Six chairs on the corner since 2016.
about_p: We opened The Corner because Liverpool had plenty of places to get your hair cut and not many to get it cut properly. Every barber here has served an apprenticeship. We take walk-ins all day, we will tell you honestly if what you have asked for will not suit you, and nobody gets rushed out of the chair.

reviews.quote: Been going three years and never had a bad cut, whoever is on. That consistency is rarer than it should be.
reviews.name: Michael Doran

reviews.quote: Walked in on a Saturday morning expecting an hour wait. Sat down in ten minutes, out in forty with the best fade I have had.
reviews.name: Jordan Achebe

reviews.quote: Took my lad for his first proper haircut. They were brilliant with him, made a fuss of him, and he has asked to go back since.
reviews.name: Steve Whelan

faq.a: No — we take walk-ins every day and that is most of our trade. You can book online if you want a specific barber or a wet shave, which takes longer.
Usually under fifteen minutes. Saturday mornings and late afternoons are busiest; mid-morning midweek you will walk straight in.
Every day. Under 12s are £11 and we have a booster seat. First haircuts are a bit of an occasion here.
